heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S handles Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 flawlessly out of the box, achieving speeds up to 286 mm/s utilizing a 24 mm³/s volumetric flow limit. No hardened nozzle or enclosure upgrades are necessary, though cracking the top glass is recommended during extended runs to mitigate heat creep.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate at 60°C (clean with warm water and detergent; no glue required)
slicerTweaks: Set Maximum Volumetric Speed to 24 mm³/s in the filament settings to safely saturate flow at 286 mm/s.
Set printing temperature to 218°C (first layer 220°C, other layers 218°C) to balance melt fluidity and layer bonding.
Cap Auxiliary Cooling Fan to 40-60% to prevent uneven shrinkage and warping on the left side of large prints.
Tune Pressure Advance to 0.022 for clean corners and seam transitions on the stock Direct Drive extruder.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Enclosed chamber temperature exceeding the glass transition threshold of PLA during prolonged printing.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Prop open the top glass cover or crack the front door slightly to vent chamber heat.

troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Auxiliary part fan cooling the print too rapidly on one side or a greasy build plate.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Wash the textured PEI plate with dish soap and reduce the auxiliary cooling fan speed to 30% in OrcaSlicer.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Surface Finish Inconsistency (Glossy vs Matte Stripes)
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Printing speed drastically varying between inner and outer perimeters at high volumetric flow rates.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Set outer wall speed to a consistent 150-180 mm/s and maintain nozzle temperature at 220°C.

faq.question: Do I need a hardened steel nozzle to print Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 on the P1S?
faq.answer: No, Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 contains no abrasive additives such as carbon fiber or glow powder, making the stock stainless steel nozzle completely suitable.

faq.question: Should the P1S door and top lid stay closed when printing PLA+?
faq.answer: It is recommended to leave the top glass propped open or the front door cracked to prevent chamber heat creep from softening filament before the heatbreak.

faq.question: Can Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 achieve Bambu High Speed print profiles?
faq.answer: Yes, with its calibrated 24 mm³/s maximum volumetric speed limit, it comfortably achieves up to 286 mm/s at standard 0.2mm layer heights.

faq.question: Does Sunlu PLA+ 2.0 require drying before use?
faq.answer: While standard PLA+ is not severely hygroscopic, pre-drying at 45-50°C for 4 hours will eliminate minor micro-stringing and optimize surface quality.
